note: Quote: "The Client Assertion is a JWT signed with the Client Secret (provided via the American Express Developers Portal) using any recommended HMAC SHA algorithm" · Required claims iss, sub, aud ([https://americanexpress.com]), exp, jti; client_assertion_type urn:ietf:params:oauth:client-assertion-type:jwt-bearer; headers X-CorrelationID (UUID), X-AMEX-API-KEY ('This is a client_id value and will be provided via the American Express Developers Portal.'), Content-Type application/x-www-form-urlencoded. The spec viewer supports four security models: oneWayTLS_AppKey, oAuth, oneWayTLS_HMAC, mTLS_HMAC (bundle). · fetch curl · verified 2026-09-25
